title: Minimum Time to Reach Target With Limited Power
summary: A signal travels directed edges, paying each edge's time and consuming cost[u] power when departing u. It may depart only with sufficient remaining power; arrival itself is free. From source with initial power, return [minimum arrival time, greatest remaining power among minimum-time paths] for target. Return [-1,-1] if unreachable. When source equals target, return [0,initial power].
officialConstraints: 1..1000 vertices; up to1000 edges; travel times 1..10^9; initial power 1..1000; departure costs 1..2000; valid vertex IDs.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
